title: Trivial Group Scheme over a Base
body_html:
Trivial Group Scheme over a Base

For any scheme \(S\), the trivial group scheme over \(S\), denoted \(\mathbf{1}_S\), is \(S\) itself, regarded as an object of \(\mathsf{Over}(S)\) via the identity structure morphism \(\operatorname{id}_S : S \to S\), equipped with the unique group object structure: multiplication, identity, and inverse are all the identity morphism of \(S\) (after suitable identifications via the unit isomorphism of the Cartesian monoidal structure on \(\mathsf{Over}(S)\)).

Equivalently, \(\mathbf{1}_S\) is the unit object of the Cartesian monoidal category \(\mathsf{Over}(S)\), which automatically carries a trivial group object structure.

The trivial group scheme is an algebraic group over \(S\): the identity morphism is both affine and locally of finite type.

In the project's Lean development, the underlying \(\texttt{Scheme.Over}\) instance is \(\texttt{schemeOverSelf}\,S\), and the group object structure is \(\texttt{trivialGrpObj}\,S\), transported from the unit of \(\mathsf{Over}(S)\) via \(\texttt{inferInstanceAs}\). The \(\texttt{IsAlgebraicGroup}\,S\,S\) instance is then synthesized automatically.

lean_refs.name: Langlands.AlgebraicGeometry.schemeOverSelf_hom
lean_refs.signature: lemma schemeOverSelf_hom (S : Scheme) : S ↘ S = 𝟙 S

lean_refs.name: Langlands.AlgebraicGeometry.trivialIsAffineHom
lean_refs.signature:
instance trivialIsAffineHom (S : Scheme) : IsAffineHom (S ↘ S) := by
  rw [schemeOverSelf_hom]; infer_instance
lean_refs.docstring: The identity structure morphism is affine.

lean_refs.name: Langlands.AlgebraicGeometry.trivialLocallyOfFiniteType
lean_refs.signature:
instance trivialLocallyOfFiniteType (S : Scheme) :
    LocallyOfFiniteType (S ↘ S) := by
  rw [schemeOverSelf_hom]; infer_instance
lean_refs.docstring: The identity structure morphism is locally of finite type.

lean_refs.name: Langlands.AlgebraicGeometry.schemeOverSelf
lean_refs.signature: instance schemeOverSelf (S : Scheme) : S.Over S := ⟨𝟙 S⟩
lean_refs.docstring: Every scheme `S` is canonically over itself via the identity morphism.

lean_refs.name: Langlands.AlgebraicGeometry.trivialGrpObj
lean_refs.signature:
noncomputable instance trivialGrpObj (S : Scheme) :
    GrpObj (Scheme.asOver S S) :=
  inferInstanceAs (GrpObj (𝟙_ (Over S)))
